text:
# =====================================================================
# NHRC Koha OPAC crawler policy
# =====================================================================

User-agent: *

# Do not crawl generated Koha searches.
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-search.pl

# Authentication / patron actions.
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-user.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-reserve.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-memberentry.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-password-recovery.pl

# VuFind is currently disabled.
Disallow: /vufind/

# Bibliographic detail pages are intentionally NOT disallowed.
#
# /cgi-bin/koha/opac-detail.pl remains crawlable.
